_comment: Thresholds and site-specific patterns for the blog tracker. Per the
tracker spec's guardrail, these live here rather than in code so they can
be tuned after a couple of months of data without a code change.
The spec asks for config.yml. This is JSON because reading YAML would mean
adding a dependency to a project that currently has exactly one, and every
value the spec names is here under the same names.
Starting values are the spec's placeholders. Tune them.

freshness._comment: Bands behind the days-since-update column. Wide on purpose: they sort attention, they do not make the call.

conformance._comment: Headings that mark a post as converted to the current Content Guide form.
conformance._moneyPathsVerify: [VERIFY] Confirm the real product and category URL patterns on adsitco.com; anything not matched here counts as a non-money internal link.
